artboards.title: Why work with us — three options

annotations.text:
WHAT ISN'T REAL YET

Everything dashed is a placeholder, not a design element.

· One quote is real — Sasenka Abeysooriya, University of Queensland. The second is not written.
· No CTI-CMM case study exists on the site; all three cards are empty.
· FAQ 2 (engagement duration) is blocked on a real number from Cosive.
· The credentials photo is an existing asset, not yet placed.

Nothing here invents a client outcome.

THE HERO IS THE DIFFERENTIATOR

No photograph. All 18 existing page banners are the same grayscale stock photo at 45% under a navy scrim — that sameness is the tell.

Instead: Color/Dark, the 24px dot grid from the about page, the sinewave line field from the blog (the Cosive mark's own equation as texture), and a blue radial tint.

Try the heroTexture tweak above the artboard to see it with the field, dots only, or flat.

THE ONE RULE

Color/Blue (#2ab6f6) is 2.30:1 on white — below even the 3:1 large-text floor. It never carries text, labels or icons on a light surface.

On Color/Dark it is 8.03:1, so every blue you see here sits on a dark ground.

Light surfaces use Color/Blue Deep (#2d6da3) — 5.49:1, and 5.49:1 again for white text on it as a button fill. The current red button is 4.25:1 and fails AA, so this is an accessibility improvement.

MOSTLY REUSE, NOT REDESIGN

New: the hero, the domain matrix, the level ladder, the engagement cycle, the tool band.

Re-skinned from existing patterns: the quote card (cloudmisp), credentials split, case-study grid, FAQ accordion, contact form.

Unchanged: the top nav, the sitemap footer, and the sinewave divider — which keeps its red stroke.

Red now appears only in the chrome.

WHY WORK WITH US — THREE OPTIONS

The blue checkmarks are kept exactly as they are, and all five claims are the existing copy, unchanged.

A · full-bleed proof band, photo in colour
B · pinned portrait, editorial claims
C · textured, no photo

The live section on page 2 of 2 is untouched until one is picked.
